notes:
Dahu 0.112.0 beta for Windows.

- Mesh panel follows Rhino's Mesh dialog: a Density slider (fewer to more polygons) and Detailed controls with Rhino names (Maximum angle, Maximum distance edge to surface, Minimum/Maximum edge length, Refine mesh, Jagged seams, Simple planes). 0 means automatic: tolerances left at 0 come from Density, and the summary reports the values used.
- OffsetCrv: Side=Pick lets the cursor choose the side and a click applies it; a locked Side ignores the pointer and a click or Enter applies it. The preview shows only the result that will be applied, with a direction arrow. New BothSides option.
- OffsetSrf: direction arrows along the surface normals (outward on a solid) and a new FlipAll option; a typed Distance only updates the preview, Enter applies.
- FilletEdge/ChamferEdge: a typed radius or distance only updates the preview; Enter applies, as in Rhino.

Unsigned: on first install choose More info > Run anyway.
